blocks.text: Gameplay settings belong to foundations_calculator-server.toml in the world’s serverconfig location. Pack defaults can be distributed through defaultconfigs. Client appearance uses the client configuration; client edits cannot replace server rules.

For a repeatable configuration change, stop the server, edit the intended existing TOML key, and restart. /reload reloads data packs; it is not a universal TOML reload command. Programmatic changes should use the validated settings API and its change notification.

blocks.text: Do not paste duplicate TOML tables or duplicate JSON object keys. Invalid guide packages are rejected with bounded diagnostics instead of being executed. Guide pages cannot run commands, read arbitrary files, or name Java classes.
Server recipe values and unlocks are not hidden solely because a guide page is marked unavailable. Server authority belongs to the gameplay service and bounded snapshot provider.

Long-valued capacity multipliers are separate from conversion ratios. Use energy.machineCapacityMultiplier, energy.itemCapacityMultiplier and energy.transferMultiplier for pack-wide scale, then per-machine/module capacityMultiplier keys for exceptions.

Presets are opt-in. balance.applyPreset=false preserves explicit R9 behavior. When enabled, balance.preset selects 1 Classic, 2 Balanced, 3 Expert or 4 High Power. /foundations config presets prints the exact effects without changing the file.

Operators can use /foundations config machine <id> for derived machine totals, /foundations config get <key> for synchronized configured values, and /foundations config find <text> to locate settings. These commands require operator permission and never change the configuration.
